items.title: MECH-440 armed-stack falsifier at the raised candidate-diversity floor (708b design, class floor=action_dim, V3-EXQ-949 yoked divergence)
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is committed_class_entropy_fraction_of_ceiling at a RAISED support_preserving_min_first_action_classes (=action_dim=5, vs 708b's hardcoded 2), combined with V3-EXQ-949-style yoked per-tick committed-action divergence + authority_rel_deviation_mean. Checked 708/708a/708b manifests: all record only the pre-commit-shape/class-entropy scalar AT THE DEFAULT FLOOR (2 classes); none combine a raised floor with a yoked measurement. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling-category autopsies for MECH-440 in the corpus (2026-08-28 check) -- NOT braked. Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: two OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entries name files this driver imports at module level -- mode-governance-engagement (not in this driver's causal path, no mode-governance knob enabled) and contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py; potentially in path via E1 but applies identically to every arm and interacts with neither the injection-site nor authority factor, biasing toward the null not a false positive) -- both carved out per the 949/947 drivers' identical precedent. Two OPEN degrading entries (mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING) also overlap causal_grid_world.py/agent.py/config.py -- noted, non-blocking. DESIGN: V3-EXQ-708b's design (same 3 arms A0_OFF/ARM_TEMP/ARM_NOISE_SINGLE, same matched SOTA conversion stack incl. use_modulatory_selection_authority=True, same 6 seeds, same P0=100/P1=50 phased training) with support_preserving_min_first_action_classes raised from 2 to action_dim, PLUS the V3-EXQ-949 yoked-pair/private-RNG-stream mechanism for P2 (reference=A0_OFF's trained agent drives the env; ARM_TEMP/ARM_NOISE_SINGLE's trained agents step on the identical observation sequence) so the run measures whether a lever that moves the pre-commit distribution shape ever reaches the COMMITTED action -- closing 708b's own honest limit ("the shape/entropy scalar cannot tell moved-the-shape from moved-the-outcome"). ARMED-CONVERSION P1 (mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 0.9 * action_dim, every arm) and P2 (authority_rel_deviation_mean > 0.05, lever-bearing arms) are MEASURED readiness gates, not assumptions; VACUITY RULE self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue if either is unmet, per V3-EXQ-949's confirmed strict-AND precedent. CEILING-HEADROOM CHECK on A0_OFF (fraction-of-ceiling < 0.90) gates the falsifying branch. PASS: ARM_NOISE_SINGLE's committed_class_entropy_fraction_of_ceiling strictly above ARM_TEMP's AND its yoked divergence vs A0_OFF clears 0.02, both on >=2/3 of >=4 divergent seeds. SECONDARY state-conditioning/self-annealing checks (per-state noise magnitude covaries with state; per-parameter sigma anneals with confidence) are NOT measured by this run -- recorded honestly as secondary_checks_measured=false; a PASS here establishes propagation only, leaving two-thirds of MECH-440 untested. SCOPE: does not refute MECH-439 F-dominance or ARC-110's intrinsic-ceiling finding; both may still hold at a raised floor -- a null here is a genuine result for the first time. SMOKE: --dry-run PASS (run twice, under the ID renames forced by live concurrent-session ID collisions on V3-EXQ-953 and V3-EXQ-954 -- see completion_note). validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 warnings). INSTRUMENT CONTROL self-yoke divergence = 0.000000 for all 3 arms (RNG isolation verified). z_goal_stream: writer_calls=273, active_frac=0.000 -- no writer defect (benefit gate correctly never opened on this tiny/short smoke). estimated_minutes calibrated directly from V3-EXQ-708b's OWN landed manifest (elapsed_seconds=58218.87 = 16.2h for the identical arms/seeds/P0/P1/P2 episode budget on ree-worker-1), +~40% for this design's added yoked-3-runner P2 pass + self-yoke control checks. Raised as GFLAG-0072 (evidence_discrepancy), 2026-08-28; proposal EXP-0593 / backlog_id EVB-0651 in manual_proposals.v1.json.

items.title: MECH-135/INV-088 E1 forward-model horizon sweep + one-step per-action divergence probe (discriminates horizon-mismatch vs action-blindness behind the V3-EXQ-108b collapse)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC probe (EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic), authored under /queue-experiment by metaworker-chip-20260825-e1-rollout-horizon-sweep-probe on ree-cloud-4 (ree-v3 0dfee208 + 0def34b7); queue append was stranded ~11h by TASK_CLAIMS contention on experiment_queue.json and completed here by chip-20260828-queue-authoring-contention-and-id-collision. QUESTION: V3-EXQ-108b found e1coe_score_var collapsed (~1e-13) across 40 distinct 30-step candidate action sequences. The commissioned lit-pull (REE_assembly/evidence/literature/targeted_review_e1_forward_model_rollout_consistency/SYNTHESIS.md Section 0) identifies TWO sufficient mechanisms: (a) horizon mismatch (E1 trained at horizon=1, used autoregressively at 30) and (b) action-blindness (e1_deep.py forward()/predict_long_horizon() take no action argument; z_self is zeroed inside predict_long_horizon). Every training-objective fix the review ranked (TD-MPC multi-step latent consistency, DaD scheduled unrolling, Asadi sequence-conditioning, PlaNet latent overshooting) targets (a) and PRESUPPOSES (b) is solved. If (b) dominates, all five are misdirected and substrate_queue.json's SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training implementation_hint is wrong about the first work item -- action-conditioning E1's transition would come first. This probe discriminates them BEFORE any substrate design work starts. DESIGN: Phases 0a/0b/1/2/3 are IDENTICAL to V3-EXQ-108b (same SD-070 z_world encoder warmup, same bespoke single-step E1/E2 training, same goal template, same warmup state, same 40 random 30-step candidate sequences) -- reuse of the existing trained E1, no objective or interface change. Phase 4 adds CR_rollout(h) at HORIZON_CHECKPOINTS [1,2,3,5,10,20,30]; Phase 4b adds a HORIZON-MATCHED CR_real(h) reference sampled independently at each checkpoint (not a single 30-step denominator); Phase 4c adds a one-step per-K-action divergence probe. Horizon-dependence of the collapse ratio -> (a); a flat/floored profile with near-zero one-step per-action divergence -> (b). SUPERSESSION / DUPLICATE WARNING: experiments/v3_exq_953_mech135_inv088_e1_horizon_sweep_action_divergence_probe.py (ree-v3 d7cbf567) is a SECOND, INDEPENDENT authoring of this SAME scientific question by a concurrent session during the same 953 ID collision. It is deliberately NOT queued: 954 carries the horizon-matched CR_real(h) reference, which 953 lacks (953 reuses one 30-step denominator at every horizon). DO NOT QUEUE V3-EXQ-953 -- it would double-run the identical question with a weaker denominator. SMOKE: --dry-run re-verified independently on DLAPTOP 2026-08-29T09:30Z (not merely inherited from the authoring session's report): PASS, label=action_blindness_confirmed, non_degenerate=True. Toy budget, NOT a finding. ESTIMATED_MINUTES derived from V3-EXQ-108b's OWN landed manifest (v3_exq_108b_mech135_inv088_zworld_disambiguation_20260802T121643Z_v3.json: elapsed_seconds=69.4 on ree-worker-3 at the identical seeds/n_train_episodes/steps_per_episode/zworld_p0_episodes config), plus generous headroom for the added 7-checkpoint sweep, 40-sample horizon-matched real reference, and action-divergence probe. RECORDING NOTE (non-blocking, for the reviewer): the smoke run prints the z_goal_stream NOT RECORDED advisory (V3-EXQ-626 / V3-EXQ-830) -- write_flat_manifest is not passed agent=; a dead z_goal stream would be invisible in this manifest. Left as authored rather than edited outside /queue-experiment. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b) -- validate_queue.py WARNs on both claims (MECH-135 count=2: 108a/108b; INV-088 count=3: MECH-457 fanout x2 + 108b) with SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training not yet IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED. ADJUDICATED EXEMPT under the validator's own stated carve-out ('a diagnostic'), and for a stronger reason than the generic one: this run is UPSTREAM OF the brake's own remedy. The brake says 'build SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training before re-testing'; this probe exists precisely to establish whether that named substrate is the correct build at all, since it presupposes mechanism (a) (horizon mismatch) and is misdirected if (b) (action-blindness) dominates. It is not a same-granularity lettered re-test of 108b's criteria (it declares no PASS/FAIL against them; supersedes=none), and INV-088's two MECH-457-fanout autopsies are on an unrelated exploration/curriculum substrate axis, not E1 dynamics.
